description: Returns the iterations of a connected issue tracker — Jira sprints (active and upcoming), and whatever a future tracker calls the same thing. Filter by name with query, for example "AFT 50". Pass the ref of the iteration you want to poker.game.tasks.import to pull its tasks into a game. Trackers without iteration support (currently Linear) return an empty list — search by text instead.

query.description: Filter iterations by name, for example "AFT 50". Omit to get all active and upcoming ones.

source.description: Tracker to query, for example jira. Required only when the team has several trackers connected — see poker.sources.list.

team_id.description: Team whose tracker is queried. Required when more than one team is available.

name: poker.iterations.list
title: List Poker Iterations Tool
